⚖️ FusionX 与 FusionX闪电?

融合X带来最真实的感觉。
FusionX 闪电是为速度和低 VRAM 设置。通过正确的提示和调整，您将获得与原始结果相媲美的结果 - 但速度更快。

注意：
👉如果你看到奇怪的粒子效应在“文本转视频”中，检查提示中是否有类似的单词灰尘, 颗粒, 抽烟等等——删除它们通常可以解决问题。

👉 体验重影或回声伪影？尝试设置你的将值移至 3.00— 这通常可以解决问题。

⚖️ FusionX vs FusionXLightning?

FusionXbrings the most realism.
FusionX Lightningis built forspeedandlow VRAM setups. With the right prompts and tuning, you’ll get results that rival the original — but way faster.

Note:
👉 If you're seeingstrange particle effectsin Text-to-Video, check your prompt for words likedust, particles, smoke, etc. — removing them usually clears it up.

👉 Experiencingghosting or echoing artifacts? Try setting yourshift value to 3.00— this typically resolves the issue.
